ink.note: Dark ground; also light-mode text and the text on red in both themes.

bone-faint.note: Clears 4.5:1 on every ground (>=4.68:1) but exists to recede: read rows, placeholders, crosses, code comments.

obi-red.note: Obi, live/playing state, and the sanctioned active-panel outline (issue #38).

scan-cyan.note: Focus, the pressed layout button, a drop target / lifted title bar, an active splitter.

code-amber.note: Docs highlighter only: flags and operators.

code-violet.note: Docs highlighter only: strings and values.

ink-faint.note: Clears 4.5:1 on every ground but exists to recede: read rows, placeholders, crosses, code comments.

obi-ink-light.note: Text on the obi and the shutter in the light theme; the dark theme uses ink.

stripe-light.note: The theme switch chevrons in the light theme; ink in the dark theme.

cover-title.purpose: The landing's cover line only; clamp(2rem, 9.6vw, 3.75rem) on phones.

display.purpose: The series name on the obi; vertical on desktop, 2.125rem for Sources/Import/Docs, clamp(3rem, 6.2vw, 6rem) on the landing, clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 1.75rem) horizontal on phones.

headline.purpose: The sheet heading; 1.25rem below 60rem. Docs section heads use the voice at 1.25rem/1.1.

closing.purpose: You're all caught up, under a full-weight rule.

deck-number.purpose: The playing STV number in the deck, in Obi Red Text; 0.875rem below 60rem.

title.purpose: Release and source titles; mixed case, underline on hover only.

deck-title.purpose: The playing title; one line, ticker when too long.

body.purpose: Page default with tabular figures; notes 1rem, hints 0.8125rem.

meta.purpose: Sources, dates, URLs, fetch times, elapsed/total.

nav.purpose: Page tabs, group links (counts in square brackets), Docs and Sign in, uppercase.

label.purpose: Every button and field label, panel names, uppercase.

code.purpose: Code blocks on the docs page; inline code is mono 500 at 0.8125em, reversed out.

effects.name: caution-chevrons
effects.purpose: Closes the foot of the vertical obi; hidden on the horizontal phone obi.

effects.name: registration-cross

effects.purpose: Spec-panel corner marks; dropped on the Sources groups head, in tiled list panels and below 60rem.

effects.name: barcode

effects.name: drop-target

motion.name: quick
motion.purpose: State changes: hover fills, color, splitter handle, panel frames.

motion.name: move
motion.purpose: Panel swaps (every tile slides), search widening, the phone reader head tucking.

motion.name: fold
motion.purpose: List folding to and from the STV strip; rows fade in from -0.75rem.

motion.name: mark-read
motion.value: 320ms; strike cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1), dim to 0.45 cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); stagger 22ms per row (max 12)

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: Newly read rows land without blinking.

motion.name: demo-read
motion.value: 520ms cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1), 1.2s + n * 0.55s; caught-up line at 4.7s over 600ms

motion.name: shutter
motion.value: 1.25s in, 0.4s hold, 1.25s out, cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1); obi ink transitions over 600ms

motion.name: ticker
motion.value: max(6s, overflow/30 + 4s) ease-in-out infinite; holds 0-18% and 50-68%

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All transitions off; no fold, strike, settle, demo, shutter or ticker animation; finished states shown.

narrative.overview:
Starve is drawn as a 90s OVA cassette cover. A red obi strip runs down the left edge and names the series (the current group) in vertical Akira caps, closed at the foot by caution chevrons. The release list beside it is the cover's spec panel: hairline-ruled rows keyed by STV catalogue numbers, with registration crosses at the sheet head's corners. Along the bottom, while something plays, a tape-transport deck shows the art, the STV number in red, the title, and a waveform that fills red as it plays and is also the seek bar. On a desktop the list, a playing video and an open post are tiled beside the obi like terminal panels, each with a mono title bar, split by draggable rules, and dragging one title bar onto another splits or swaps them.

The same drawing exists twice. Dark is the cover on ink and light is the cover on bone paper, chosen by `prefers-color-scheme` unless the obi's switch has chosen. Both keep square corners, outlined mono controls, and a fine film grain over everything. Display type is loud and expanded, but reading text stays in mixed-case Archivo at reading sizes. The poster attitude belongs to the frame. The list itself is for reading. Signed out, the same world plays at full volume: the landing is the cassette's J-card, with a wider obi and a cover title at poster size.

The world rejects the reader/music-app default of a grey sidebar, rounded cards and pill buttons. It also rejects all-caps reading text.
keyCharacteristics: A full-height red obi band (5.5rem; wider on the landing) at the left on desktop, a horizontal red band under the top bar on phones.
A spec-panel list: STV number, art cell, title over source, date, actions, all on hairline rules.
A tiled desktop workspace: list, video and post as panels with title bars, hairline frames and splitters; the active panel outlined in red.
A fixed player deck with a red top rule and a waveform seek bar.
Three type voices with strict jobs: Akira for display, Archivo for reading, Martian Mono for numbers, controls and code.
Square corners everywhere, with no shadows. Depth comes from tone, rules and grain.
Red means obi, live, or the active panel. Cyan means focus, the chosen layout, a drop target or an active splitter.

rules.name: The Obi Red Rule
rules.body: Red is for the obi and for live/playing state only, meaning what plays now and the video that is playing. Never use it as a general accent, link color or emphasis. One sanctioned exception, asked for by the user (issue #38): the active workspace panel, the one last clicked or focused, is outlined in red and its title-bar marker turns red. It does not extend to any other "selected" or "current" state.

rules.name: The Scanline Rule
rules.body: Cyan means focus, the chosen layout, where a dragged panel will land, or an active splitter, nothing else. If it isn't telling you where focus is or where something goes, it isn't cyan.

rules.name: The Code Ink Rule
rules.body: Amber and violet exist only inside code blocks. They never colour a control, a heading or a state.

rules.name: The Same Drawing Rule
rules.body: Every surface ships in both themes from the same tokens. A new color needs a dark value and a light value, or it doesn't ship.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Akira is for display only: the wordmark, the obi series name, the landing's cover title, sheet and docs headings, the deck STV number and "caught up". Archivo, in mixed case, carries every title and all body text. Martian Mono carries STV/SRC numbers, dates, sources, control labels and code. Never set reading text in Akira, and never set reading text in all caps.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Regions are separated by 1px rules, never by shadows or cards. The strongest separation is a 1px rule in the text color.

dos: **Do** set the wordmark, obi series name, cover title, sheet and docs headings, the deck STV number and "caught up" in Akira Expanded 800, uppercase, at `font-stretch: 125%`.
**Do** set every title and all body text in Archivo, mixed case. Set STV/SRC numbers, dates, sources, control labels and code in Martian Mono.
**Do** ship every color in both themes, following `prefers-color-scheme` unless the obi switch has set `data-theme` on the root.
**Do** keep row dates aligned with the fixed 13.5rem actions column, and keep an empty art cell when a row has no art.
**Do** let rows respond to the sheet's container width (64rem fold, 34rem buttons-under-title), not the viewport.
**Do** make a button beside a field, or in a row that contains one, 2.5rem tall.
**Do** draw icons as inline SVG in `currentColor`; show a pressed toggle by inverting it, not by colouring it.

**Do** keep state changes at 150ms (`cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`), panel swaps, the search widening and the reader head's tuck at 240ms, and the list fold at 280ms. Under `prefers-reduced-motion`, use no transitions, no fold animation, no strike or demo animation and no ticker.
**Do** move only the video's box between panels and layouts, never the iframe, so playback never restarts.
**Do** give phones a single video placement: full width above the deck.
**Do** run theme changes and page switches through the shutter, at one speed, and keep the scrollbar gutter reserved (`scrollbar-gutter: stable`) so switching pages never changes the page width.
donts: **Don't** use Akira for reading text, and don't set reading text in all caps.
**Don't** use red for anything but the obi, live/playing state and the active workspace panel.
**Don't** use cyan for anything but focus, the chosen layout, a drop target or the active splitter.
**Don't** use the code hues (amber, violet) outside code blocks.
**Don't** round corners, use pill buttons or cards, or add shadows.
**Don't** use the faint text tier (`bone-faint` / `ink-faint`) as the main voice: it clears 4.5:1 on every ground (≥4.68:1) but exists to recede, for read rows and placeholders.
**Don't** commit the Akira font files. They are personal-use and gitignored.
**Don't** colour the page scrollbar: it stays the strong hairline on the ground (tried in red and rejected).
